assertionResults.reason: Repo-bound CLI JSON, the authenticated local GET /v1/env endpoint, and the browser Env section all reported the same machine-readable classification: trust_model `local_only`, custody `machine_local`, portability `local_only`, and shared_state `plaintext_compatible`. The backend remained a local keychain secret backend with portable_state `not_configured`, and the browser explicitly warned that plaintext-compatible/local-only env must not be treated as broker-managed shared portable state.

The frozen mission issue inventory remained explicit in the seeded mission and repo scope files, and the current repo-bound Linear audit reconciled that scope to 13/13 resolved with 0 unresolved items. The published closeout artifact was `Mission closeout audit`, the delivery audit stayed available with 0 conflicts recorded, and the browser Linear section surfaced the same `Resolved 13/13`, `Unresolved 0`, delivery-audit path, and closeout evidence path.

Two consecutive `./dist/hack linear status --json` runs returned the same repair guidance, default route, latest published status update, delivery audit, and closeout payload even though broker-owned Linear access is currently not connected. The browser Linear section showed the same not-connected repair state, the same repo-bound route to Hack, the same `Mission closeout audit` artifact, and the same delivery/closeout counts, while targeted Linear regressions covering publish/delivery/closeout retry behavior and closeout-specific evidence anchoring passed cleanly.

frictions.description: The routed `/account` page emitted a React hydration-mismatch console error during browser validation.
frictions.resolution: The rendered Env and Linear sections still matched the CLI/API evidence, so validation proceeded, but the console error remains a browser-surface defect.

frictions.description: agent-browser did not capture network request entries for the routed account page during this local validation flow.
frictions.resolution: Used direct curl/CLI outputs plus extracted browser section text to confirm the same env and Linear state instead of relying on the empty request log.

commands.observation: Both repo-bound env commands succeeded and consistently classified the current env state as local_only/plaintext_compatible with local keychain-backed secret custody and no portable bundle configured.

commands.command: <repo>/dist/hack x gateway token-create --scope read --json && curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <read-gateway-token>" http://127.0.0.1:7788/v1/env?project=hack-cli && <repo>/dist/hack x gateway token-revoke <token-id> --json
commands.observation: A temporary local read token let the validator fetch the daemon env HTTP payload, which matched the CLI classification and was revoked immediately after capture.
Targeted env regressions passed 20/20 tests, including env backend status JSON, daemon /v1/env responses, plaintext compatibility, and portable-state handling.
Created a disposable Better Auth email/password account and isolated its session cookie jar under the assigned evidence directory.

commands.command: agent-browser --session web-env-linear-state open https://auth.hack-cli.hack/health && cookies set __Secure-better-auth.session_token <redacted> && open https://auth.hack-cli.hack/auth/account?bridge=1&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fhack-cli.hack%2Faccount
commands.observation: Bootstrapped the dedicated browser session into the routed account page and captured full-page plus section-level env/Linear evidence for the isolated disposable account.

Both runs reported the same repo-bound Linear routing/audit state and the same repair guidance (`hack auth login`) while still surfacing identical latestPublished, delivery, and closeout payloads with 0 unresolved items.
Targeted Linear regressions passed 89/89 tests, including publish/delivery reconciliation, closeout-specific evidence anchoring, and retry/idempotency behavior.

summary: Passed 3/3 assertions. Env trust/custody/portability stayed honest across CLI, HTTP, and browser surfaces; the frozen mission Linear scope resolved to 13/13 done with zero unresolved items; and repeated repo-bound Linear status plus the browser Linear section remained consistent and auditable on retry. Setup friction: the routed account page logged a hydration-mismatch console error, and agent-browser captured no request log entries for this SSR flow.
